en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of uniformed officers posing in front of a building with large open doors. The men wear early 20th‑century military dress with peaked caps and boots. Under the image there is printed bilingual text in Swedish and Finnish referring to the Finnish Guard Battalion officer corps. Across the lower part of the image, a large handwritten Finnish word is visible.
